desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to run-level swaps/deletions and identify that effective swaps save one operation while neutral swaps can enable later effective swaps.
Discovered that the simple greedy “valid four-run patterns with gap >= 3” is insufficient; neutral swaps can create new effective patterns (e.g. 1 2 1 3 2 3).
Derived a candidate 3-state DP over runs that processes the first run, allowing delete-first, neutral front swap + delete, or effective front swap + delete.
Implement RLE and the 3-state DP in Python with O(N) time per test case and fast input/output.
Validate the DP against the public samples and small brute-force/BFS reasoning, including long runs and neutral-swap chains.
Finalize the solution; no further sub-tasks.
